about: Server cvars and console commands offered by the config editor. Every entry carries the source of its description; regenerate with scripts/gen_cvar_catalog.py.

sources.server.cfg: the game's own annotated example server.cfg
sources.naming: read off the cvar name - not verified on a live server
sources.listcvars: a listcvars dump only - no description

commands.name: set
commands.description: Sets a cvar (no archive flag).

commands.name: seta
commands.description: Sets a cvar with the archive flag.

commands.name: exec
commands.description: Executes a configuration file.

commands.name: vstr
commands.description: Executes commands stored in a cvar.

commands.name: alias
commands.description: Creates a command alias.

commands.name: unalias
commands.description: Removes a single alias.

commands.name: bind
commands.description: Binds a key to a command or alias.

commands.name: unbind
commands.description: Removes a single bind on a key.

commands.name: unbindall
commands.description: Removes all set binds.

commands.name: toggle
commands.description: Inverts a cvar's boolean value.

commands.name: reset
commands.description: Resets a cvar to its initial value.

commands.name: clearcvar
commands.description: Clears a cvar's value, setting it to "".

commands.name: cvar_restart
commands.description: Restarts the cvar subsystem, clearing most cvar changes.

commands.name: writeconfig
commands.description: Writes a config with all set cvars and binds.

commands.name: condump
commands.description: Dumps all buffered console text to a file.

commands.name: echo
commands.description: Prints text to the console.

commands.name: wait
commands.description: Waits one frame (or N frames) before continuing.

commands.name: map
commands.description: Loads a map normally.

commands.name: devmap
commands.description: Loads a map in development/cheats mode.

commands.name: map_restart
commands.description: Reloads the map and entities and respawns all players.

commands.name: startRandomMap
commands.description: Runs a random map from the map pool file.

commands.name: reload_mappool
commands.description: Reloads the map pool file from sv_mapPoolFile. The pool is otherwise only read at server init.

commands.name: kick
commands.description: Kicks a player by name.

commands.name: clientkick
commands.description: Kicks a player or bot by client ID.

commands.name: say
commands.description: Sends a message from the server.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Lists all clients with IDs, scores, ping, IP and Steam ID.

commands.name: serverinfo
commands.description: Displays the serverinfo cvars clients and the browser see.

commands.name: listcvars
commands.description: Lists all cvars, with optional filtering.

commands.name: listcmds
commands.description: Lists all commands, with optional filtering.

commands.name: killserver
commands.description: Unloads the current map; the process keeps running.

commands.name: quit
commands.description: Exits the server process immediately.

cvars.name: appendlogfile
cvars.description: Append to the existing console log instead of overwriting it at startup.

cvars.name: arch
cvars.description: Platform the server binary was built for.

cvars.name: armor_tiered
cvars.description: Tiered armour system (green/yellow/red absorb differently) on or off.

cvars.name: bot_autoReady
cvars.description: Bots ready up automatically in warmup.

cvars.name: bot_challenge
cvars.description: Bots play more aggressively.

cvars.name: bot_dynamicSkill
cvars.description: Bot skill adapts to the players.

cvars.name: bot_enable
cvars.description: Bots may be added to the server.

cvars.name: bot_fastchat
cvars.description: Bots chat more often.

cvars.name: bot_followDist
cvars.description: Distance a following bot keeps.

cvars.name: bot_gauntlet
cvars.description: Bots may use the gauntlet.

cvars.name: bot_gauntletOnly
cvars.description: Bots use the gauntlet only.

cvars.name: bot_grapple
cvars.description: Bots may use the grappling hook.

cvars.name: bot_instaGibAimSkill
cvars.description: Bot aim skill in instagib.

cvars.name: bot_itemDelayTime
cvars.description: Delay before bots go for an item.

cvars.name: bot_minplayers
cvars.description: Bots are added until this many players are in the game.

cvars.name: bot_nochat
cvars.description: Bots stay silent.

cvars.name: bot_pause
cvars.description: Freeze all bots.

cvars.name: bot_rocketjump
cvars.description: Bots may rocket jump.

cvars.name: bot_startingSkill
cvars.description: Skill level new bots start at.

cvars.name: bot_teamkill
cvars.description: Bots may hurt their own team.

cvars.name: bot_thinktime
cvars.description: Milliseconds between bot think frames.

cvars.name: bot_training
cvars.description: Bot training mode.

cvars.name: capturelimit
cvars.description: Flag captures needed to win a CTF-style match.

cvars.name: close_stdout
cvars.description: Close standard output after startup.

cvars.name: cm_noAreas
cvars.description: Ignore area portals in the collision model (debugging).

cvars.name: cm_noCurves
cvars.description: Ignore curved surfaces in the collision model (debugging).

cvars.name: cm_playerCurveClip
cvars.description: Players collide with curved surfaces.

cvars.name: com_allowConsole
cvars.description: Console can be opened.

cvars.name: com_build
cvars.description: Engine build number.

cvars.name: com_crashed
cvars.description: Set by the engine after a crash.

cvars.name: com_errormessage
cvars.description: Last error message the engine produced.

cvars.name: com_hunkMegs
cvars.description: May need to be increased for additional players.

cvars.name: com_idleSleep
cvars.description: Sleep when idle to give CPU time back.

cvars.name: com_maxfps
cvars.description: Frame rate cap for the process.

cvars.name: com_pid
cvars.description: Process ID of the running server.

cvars.name: com_speeds
cvars.description: Print frame timing information.

cvars.name: com_zoneMegs
cvars.description: Zone memory size in MB.

cvars.name: dedicated
cvars.description: Dedicated server mode: 0 = listen server, 1 = LAN, 2 = internet. Normally set on the command line at launch.

cvars.name: developer
cvars.description: Extra engine debug output in the console.

cvars.name: dmflags
cvars.description: Deathmatch flags bitmask inherited from Quake 3. The official Clan Arena factories set 28; the meaning of the individual bits is not verified for Quake Live.

cvars.name: fixedtime
cvars.description: Run the simulation with a fixed frame time (debugging).

cvars.name: fraglimit
cvars.description: Frags needed to win the match; 0 means no frag limit.

cvars.name: fs_basegame
cvars.description: Base game directory name.

cvars.name: fs_basepath
cvars.description: Read-only directory the base game data is installed in.

cvars.name: fs_cdpath
cvars.description: Extra read-only data path.

cvars.name: fs_copyfiles
cvars.description: Copy files from the read-only paths into the home path.

cvars.name: fs_copypath
cvars.description: Destination path used by fs_copyfiles.

cvars.name: fs_debug
cvars.description: Log every file system access.

cvars.name: fs_game
cvars.description: Mod or game directory the server runs out of (normally baseq3).

cvars.name: fs_homepath
cvars.description: Writable data directory the server reads and writes configs, plugins and downloads in.

cvars.name: fs_restrict
cvars.description: Restrict the file system to shipped content.

cvars.name: fs_skipWorkshop
cvars.description: Ignore Steam Workshop content when loading files.

cvars.name: g_accelRate_pg
cvars.description: Acceleration rate of a Plasma Gun projectile.

cvars.name: g_accelRate_rl
cvars.description: Acceleration rate of a Rocket Launcher projectile.

cvars.name: g_accessFile
cvars.description: Used to determine which 64-bit Steam IDs have admin access, or are banned.

cvars.name: g_adCaptureScoreBonus
cvars.description: Score bonus for capturing in Attack and Defend.

cvars.name: g_adElimScoreBonus
cvars.description: Score bonus for an elimination in Attack and Defend.

cvars.name: g_adTouchScoreBonus
cvars.description: Score bonus for touching the objective in Attack and Defend.

cvars.name: g_allowCustomHeadmodels
cvars.description: Allow custom head models on player models.

cvars.name: g_allowForfeit

cvars.name: g_allowKill

cvars.description: Allow spectators to call votes

cvars.description: Turn off all votes

cvars.name: g_allowVoteMidGame
cvars.description: Don't allow callvotes once the map has started

cvars.name: g_allTalk
cvars.description: 0: Limit voice comms to teams during match 1: Allow all players to talk to each other always 2: 1+ send back your own voice to yourself for testing

cvars.name: g_ammoPack
cvars.description: Ammo pack pickups enabled.

cvars.name: g_ammoPackHack
cvars.description: Legacy compatibility flag for ammo pack behaviour.

cvars.name: g_ammoRespawn
cvars.description: Seconds before a picked-up ammo box reappears.

cvars.name: g_autoAction
cvars.description: Bitmask for automatic per-match actions such as demo recording and screenshots.

cvars.name: g_banIPs
cvars.description: IP addresses banned from the server.

cvars.description: Damage reduction the Battle Suit applies.

cvars.name: g_customSettings

cvars.description: Bitmask of what players may drop with the drop command.

cvars.description: Score bonus for returning a dropped flag.

cvars.name: g_dropPowerups
cvars.description: Players drop their powerups when killed.

cvars.name: g_dropSkulls
cvars.description: Players drop skulls when killed (Harvester).

cvars.name: g_enableDust
cvars.description: Dust effects enabled.

cvars.name: g_enemyTeamRespawnRatio
cvars.description: Scales the respawn delay by how many enemies are still alive.

cvars.name: g_factory
cvars.description: ID of the factory the current match was started with.

cvars.name: g_freezeEnvironmentalRespawnDelay

cvars.name: g_freezeProtectedSpawnTime
cvars.description: Spawn protection time in Freeze Tag.

cvars.name: g_freezeRemovePowerupsOnRound

cvars.name: g_freezeThawWinningTeam
cvars.description: Thawing rules for the winning team.

cvars.name: g_friendlyFire
cvars.description: Team-mates can damage each other.

cvars.name: g_friendlyFireDampen
cvars.description: Scaling applied to friendly fire damage.

cvars.name: g_gameState
cvars.description: Current match state as reported by the engine.

cvars.name: g_gametype
cvars.description: Gametype ID of the running match (0 = FFA, 3 = TDM, 4 = CA, 5 = CTF and so on). On a dedicated server this comes from the factory the map was started with, not from server.cfg.

cvars.name: g_gauntletSpeedFactor
cvars.description: Speed boost while holding the gauntlet.

cvars.name: g_grantItemOnSpawn
cvars.description: Item granted to a player every time they spawn.

cvars.description: Player loadout selection enabled.
